races.paceDynamic: Naughty Niall will dictate terms from the front with minimal pressure, creating a sustainable gallop that could prove too methodical for closers. Daring Leader may track prominently but lacks the early speed to challenge Naughty Niall's supremacy. The modest pace will compress the field turning for home, but the real damage comes when the tempo lifts - hold-up horses like Crafter, Port Noir and Ciotog face a wall of horses and limited room to manoeuvre in the straight. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can position close to the pace and kick clear when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If Naughty Niall gets an easy lead and quickens decisively two furlongs out
scenarios.body: The soft sectionals allow him to reserve energy for a telling burst, while hold-up horses struggle to pick up the pieces from off the pace. His proven stamina and tactical speed become decisive assets.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and the field bunches entering the straight
scenarios.body: The compressed finish creates gaps for patient riders, allowing horses like Crafter and Port Noir to utilise their finishing kicks. Recent form winners benefit from the tactical free-for-all.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Naughty Niall and Daring Leader go too fast early and tie up in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where lighter-weighted horses with residual stamina can pounce late. Kaaress drops significantly in the weights and could benefit from the collapse.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Daring Leader stalks Naughty Niall perfectly and times his challenge to perfection
scenarios.body: His recent winning form and tactical positioning allow him to strike at the optimal moment when the leader begins to tire. The consistent pace plays to his strengths without demanding exceptional finishing speed.

watchPoints.text: Naughty Niall returning from 51-day break - watch for early signs of rustiness or laboured breathing in the preliminaries
Crafter and Ciotog both trained by Loughnane with identical weights - stable tactics could determine which horse gets the stronger ride
Dors Delight and Eager Puccini both carry fading warnings - monitor their positions turning for home as they may weaken rapidly
Port Noir dropping back from 8f to this longer trip after recent sprint success - watch if he settles properly in the early stages
Multiple hold-up runners with 5lb claiming jockeys aboard - watch for traffic problems and late room in what could become a bunched finish

races.paceDynamic: Astrological will lead from the gates with Favourite Friend likely to track closely in second, creating a modest gallop over this extended trip. The bulk of the field including Zooter, Close To Me, Maryland Star, King's Courtier and Oceanides will settle in behind, while Helios Path's hold-up style means it will be further back still. With only two genuine early pace elements, the tempo will be steady rather than testing, allowing the field to stay compact through the middle stages. This moderate pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses and patient riders who can produce late kicks, as the leaders will be sitting ducks in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Patient Hold-Up Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays modest as expected with Astrological and Favourite Friend setting gentle fractions.
scenarios.body: The field stays bunched allowing closers to unleash finishing kicks, with the early leaders vulnerable to being swamped. Hold-up horses like Zooter and potentially Helios Path can time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Capitalize
scenarios.trigger: If Astrological maintains a steady rhythm without folding and gets first run on the field.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows Astrological to dictate terms and kick clear, while other prominent runners like Favourite Friend can follow through. The hold-up brigade leaves it too late to make serious inroads.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If both Astrological and Favourite Friend go too slow early and create a sprint finish.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test over the final three furlongs where tactical positioning trumps stamina. Horses with the best turn of foot regardless of early position can capitalize on the crawling pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Meltdown
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders completely stop and the race becomes pedestrian throughout.
scenarios.body: The contest turns into a messy affair where any horse can win from any position, creating chaos in the final furlong. Form and class become secondary to who gets the clearest run and luckiest passage.

watchPoints.text: Astrological sets funeral pace early - if fractions are too slow the leaders become sitting ducks for late runners
Helios Path's fitness after 161-day layoff - any signs of greenness or rustiness could derail upset claims
Close To Me's ability to handle the weight penalty - extra 12lbs on a 4-year-old could prove decisive late
Favourite Friend's readiness after long break - Prescott horses can be fresh first time but need watching for market confidence
Zooter's positioning through the early stages - needs to be handy enough to strike but not caught wide without cover

races.paceDynamic: Midnight Call will likely lead with minimal early pressure, as most runners prefer hold-up or prominent tactics. Kento and Nad Alshiba Snow may press forward early but both can settle, leaving Midnight Call to dictate a steady tempo. With 8 of 10 declared runners showing hold-up tendencies, the pace will be sustainable through halfway before quickening in the final 2f. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent racers and early leaders who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large hold-up contingent.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Midnight Call gets an easy lead with minimal early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for the hold-up brigade to make up ground, and Midnight Call's recent wins at this trip prove she can sustain her effort. The prominent runners like Kento get first run on the leaders while the field bunches behind.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Kento and Nad Alshiba Snow press Midnight Call early then settle
scenarios.body: A genuine pace develops that suits horses who can track the speed without getting too far back in this large field. Kento's excellent recent form and Rossa Ryan's tactical nous become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Heroes Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is very slow and the hold-up horses get clear runs
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where Henery Hawk's consistent place record and Some Nightmare's tactical speed give them the edge over tiring leaders. Traffic becomes less of an issue with a strong pace collapse.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Midnight Call goes too slow and multiple horses challenge simultaneously
scenarios.body: The finish becomes messy with tired leaders and traffic-affected hold-up horses, allowing an outsider like Nad Alshiba Snow to benefit from a patient ride and lighter weight. Form lines become irrelevant in the scramble.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Midnight Call getting too easy a lead - if she's alone after 2f, the hold-up horses may struggle to make up ground

Watch for headgear effects on Some Nightmare and Isla Bella - both have equipment changes suggesting connections expect improvement

With only four runners and one confirmed front runner, Renesmee can dictate a steady tempo without serious pressure through the early stages of this 1m4f trip. The lack of pace pressure should create a sustainable gallop that builds gradually, allowing the patient hold-up horses to time their challenges from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can quicken from the back, as the modest early pace will leave plenty in reserve for the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate

scenarios.body: The patient tactics of Camino Del Ray and Youarenotforgiven become a major asset as they conserve energy for a strong finish. Both can produce their best work when allowed to quicken from behind a steady tempo over this stamina-testing distance.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where current form and weight advantages matter most. Youarenotforgiven's recent back-to-back wins could prove decisive in a blanket finish where stamina reserves are less important.

races.paceDynamic: Naana's Crystal is the sole natural pace-setter in this small field and will be allowed to dictate terms from the front without pressure. With Della Pace, Siam Ruby, and Fille Imbassee all confirmed hold-up performers, the early pace will be steady to moderate. This creates a tactical nightmare for the three closers who must rely on each other for pace pressure that likely won't materialise. The race shape strongly favours the front-runner profile, as Naana's Crystal can control fractions and kick when ready against horses who prefer stronger gallops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Naana's Crystal gets the soft lead she's expected to receive
scenarios.body: The filly dictates comfortable fractions and has plenty left for a decisive move, while the three hold-up horses struggle to get competitive without pace pressure. This perfectly suits prominent/leading types who can control their own destiny.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the modest early pace still creates enough stretch run for closers to unleash
scenarios.body: Despite the tactical disadvantage, one of the hold-up horses finds enough acceleration to reel in Naana's Crystal in the final furlong. Superior class or fitness overcomes the unfavourable race shape.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Surprise Early Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Della Pace or another breaks character to press Naana's Crystal early
scenarios.body: An unexpected pace battle develops when a natural closer gets aggressive early, creating genuine tempo and opening the race up for a different type of finish. This benefits horses with tactical speed who can adapt.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Crawling Pace Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely pedestrian with all horses tracking
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the final three furlongs when no one wants to make the running. Turn of foot becomes everything in a slowly-run tactical affair.

watchPoints.text: Naana's Crystal must be monitored for fitness after 57 days off, as any sluggishness early could invite unexpected pressure
Watch for Della Pace breaking character early given Spencer's tactical nous and the mare's long absence
Siam Ruby's recent sharp form means she could still win despite the tactical disadvantage if the pace quickens late

Track the sectional times early as a truly crawling pace could neutralise Naana's Crystal's front-running advantage
